title: Professional Business Directory — `professionals` collection document
description: Enterprise schema for a single document in the production Firestore `professionals` collection. This is a distinct data asset from `businesses` — it models paid professional-service listings (educators, real estate specialists, etc.), not the general Black-owned business directory. Website-backend scope only; no mobile-app/external-consumer fields are populated in this version.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the professional who owns this listing. Immutable after creation; security rules key off this field.

businessName.description: Public-facing display name of the professional/practice.

verifiedStatus.description: Set exclusively by admin review. Gates public read access — unauthenticated users only ever see documents where this is true.

category.description: Service category slug, e.g. 'educator', 'real_estate_specialist'. Kept as a free-form string in v1; consider promoting to a controlled `professional_categories` collection (mirroring the existing `business_tags` pattern) once the category list stabilizes.

contactEmail.description: Public contact address shown on the verified profile.

tierLevel.description: 'basic_50_mo': flat $50/month entry tier (web presence + CMS tools). 'hourly_retainer': dynamic/advanced pricing for professionals operating beyond standard hours — actual rate terms live in Stripe (Price/Product), not duplicated here, to avoid drift between Firestore and the billing source of truth.

subscriptionActive.description: System-managed only. Toggled exclusively by the Stripe webhook controller (see app/api/webhooks/stripe-professionals/route.ts) in response to customer.subscription.updated / invoice.payment_succeeded / invoice.payment_failed. Never client-writable — enforced in firestore.rules via a field-level lockdown on top of the uid+subscriptionActive gate.

stripeCustomerId.description: Stripe Customer ID for billing. This is the join key the webhook controller uses to find the matching professionals doc for incoming subscription/invoice events.

stripeConnectAccountId.description: Stripe Connect account ID the professional's net payout routes to (destination charge target).

referralPercentage.description: Decimal commission (e.g. 0.10 = 10%) routed back to MKE Black's core platform/referral wallet on top of Stripe's own platform fee, for having driven the professional's user acquisition. Applied in lib/stripe/professionals.ts.

visitorCount.description: Cumulative profile view count. Incremented server-side; not client-writable.

interactionLog.description: Structured click-analytics payload. Append-only from the client (via a narrow, validated Cloud Function/API route — not raw Firestore writes) to prevent tampering with billing-adjacent trust signals.

type.description: external_link: outbound link click. phone_dialer: tel: link tap. share: share-sheet trigger.

target.description: Opaque identifier for what was interacted with (URL, formatted phone number, share destination). Avoid storing additional PII here.

occurredAt.description: Firestore Timestamp on write; ISO 8601 string in this schema doc for portability.

externalSync.description: RESERVED, INTENTIONALLY EMPTY in this session. Placeholder map for a future mobile-app / external-consumer read integration. Do not populate or add properties here yet — that is a separate, later task once the app's concrete data contract is defined. Keeping this field present now (as an empty object) means that future integration is additive-only and requires no breaking migration of existing documents.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp at document creation.

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp, updated on every write.
